title: Ethiopian Lentil and Vegetable Stew
localName: ምስር አትክልት ወጥ — Misir Atkilit Wat
community: Modern Ethiopian kitchens — lentils and vegetables combined
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Ethiopian Lentil and Vegetable Stew — red lentils cooked with diced carrots, potatoes, and tomatoes in a berbere sauce. The combined protein and vegetable one-pot — the lentils dissolve into the sauce while the vegetables retain their texture.
longDesc: Lentil and vegetable stew is the modern family fasting pot — combining the protein of Misir Wat with the nutrition of mixed vegetables into a single pot that is both filling and complete.
steps: Add oil and berbere. Fry 3 minutes.
Add garlic and tomatoes. Cook 4 minutes.
Add lentils. Add water. Simmer 20 minutes.
Add potatoes and carrots. Simmer 20 more minutes.
chefTips: Add vegetables after the lentils have been cooking 20 minutes.
cookingScience: Adding the root vegetables after partial lentil cooking allows the lentils to dissolve and thicken the sauce before the vegetables go in — if all ingredients are added together, the vegetables break down before the lentils have had time to produce their natural thickening.
servedWith: As a complete fasting one-pot meal
healthBenefits: Very complete nutrition — protein, complex carbohydrate, multiple vitamins.
culturalNote: Lentil and vegetable stew is modern Ethiopia's practical fasting answer — one pot, complete nutrition, family-friendly, efficient. The ancient berbere tradition applied to the contemporary family's needs.
